mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO meter (id, tenant_id, device_id, facility_id, parameter_id, unit_id, code, display_name, meter_kind, calculation_expression, rollover_modulus, decimal_scale, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{meter.id}, #{meter.tenantId}, #{meter.deviceId}, #{meter.facilityId}, #{meter.parameterId}, #{meter.unitId}, #{meter.code}, #{meter.displayName}, #{meter.meterKind},
CAST(#{meter.calculationExpression} AS jsonb) NULL , #{meter.rolloverModulus}, #{meter.decimalScale}, #{meter.status}, #{meter.version}, #{meter.createdAt}, #{meter.updatedAt})

INSERT INTO integration_outbox (id, tenant_id, topic, partition_key, event_type, payload, status, attempts, available_at, occurred_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{topic}, #{partitionKey}, #{eventType}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), 'PENDING', 0, #{occurredAt}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT device.tenant_id, organization.path AS organization_path, device.model_version FROM device JOIN organization ON organization.id = device.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = device.tenant_id WHERE device.id = #{deviceId} AND device.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT parameter.value_semantics AS semantics, source_unit.code AS source_unit_code, canonical_unit.code AS canonical_unit_code, source_unit.scale, source_unit.offset_value AS offset, COALESCE(parameter.decimal_scale, CASE WHEN parameter.data_type = 'INTEGER' THEN 0 ELSE 6 END) AS default_decimal_scale FROM parameter_definition parameter JOIN unit_catalog source_unit ON source_unit.id = #{unitId} JOIN unit_catalog canonical_unit ON canonical_unit.id = parameter.canonical_unit_id AND canonical_unit.dimension = source_unit.dimension WHERE parameter.id = #{parameterId} AND parameter.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT count(*) FROM facility WHERE id = #{facilityId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT meter.id, meter.tenant_id, meter.device_id, meter.facility_id, meter.parameter_id, meter.unit_id, meter.code, meter.display_name, meter.meter_kind, meter.calculation_expression::text AS calculation_expression, meter.rollover_modulus, meter.decimal_scale, meter.status, meter.version, meter.created_at, meter.updated_at, parameter.value_semantics AS semantics, organization.path AS organization_path, canonical_unit.code AS canonical_unit_code, COALESCE(facility.zone_id, organization.zone_id, tenant.default_zone_id) AS effective_zone_id FROM meter JOIN device ON device.id = meter.device_id AND device.tenant_id = meter.tenant_id JOIN organization ON organization.id = device.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = device.tenant_id JOIN parameter_definition parameter ON parameter.id = meter.parameter_id JOIN unit_catalog canonical_unit ON canonical_unit.id = parameter.canonical_unit_id JOIN tenant ON tenant.id = meter.tenant_id LEFT JOIN facility ON facility.id = meter.facility_id AND facility.tenant_id = meter.tenant_id WHERE meter.id = #{meterId}
